title: Wise Words
subtitle: Wisdom and Inspiration in Your Pocket
description: A motivational quote app for saving and sharing favorites, built as my final school project for the iOS course.
descriptionLong: Wise Words is a motivational quotes app developed using Swift and SwiftUI. It features a clean and intuitive interface, allowing users to discover, save, and share their favorite quotes effortlessly. Key technical highlights include MVVM architecture for maintainability, SwiftData for efficient data storage, asynchronous programming for smooth user experience, custom animations for transitions, comprehensive unit and UI testing, widget support for home screen quotes, swipe gestures for navigation, and SwiftUI's environment and state management for dynamic updates.

title: Morning and Evening Supplication
subtitle: In Swedish, Arabic & Transliteration
description: Morning and evening supplications in Swedish, Arabic & Transliteration.
descriptionLong: Morgon & Kvällsåminnelser is a React Native app built with Expo, offering morning and evening reminders through a user-friendly interface. It uses MVVM architecture, AsyncStorage for data storage, and Expo Router for navigation. Custom animations, haptic feedback (expo-haptics), and real-time updates via React hooks enhance the experience. Styled with Tailwind CSS, the app ensures simplicity and responsiveness.

title: Coinnect Four
subtitle: Coin-Themed Mobile App for Android
description: A multiplayer Connect Four game with a unique coin theme, developed for my Android course final project.
descriptionLong: Coinnect Four is a coin-themed Connect Four game developed with Lavdim. This Android app uses Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for smooth gameplay. The UI, designed in Figma, is implemented with custom Composable functions. It follows MVVM architecture, using ViewModel and LiveData for state management. Kotlin coroutines handle asynchronous tasks for fluid operations. Custom modules manage game logic, while networking components enable multiplayer interactions with secure protocols for real-time synchronization. This project enhanced my skills in modular design, state management, and modern Android development.

title: Lite Weather
subtitle: Minimalist & Weather Forecasts for iOS
description: A minimalist weather app offering precise forecasts for up to five days with real-time location tracking.
descriptionLong: Lite Weather is a SwiftUI-based app offering precise weather forecasts for up to five days. It leverages CoreLocation for real-time location tracking and Open-Meteo API for weather data. The app features a clean, intuitive UI with dynamic weather icons and detailed daily forecasts, ensuring users receive timely and accurate weather updates.

title: Rentingforce Expo App Migration
subtitle: Modernizing the RentingForce App with Expo
description: Migrating and modernizing the RentingForce app from React Native CLI to Expo.
descriptionLong: The RentingForce Expo App is a React Native project focused on modernizing the existing application by transitioning to Expo. The project that i assisted replaced outdated dependencies, improved maintainability, and optimized performance for smoother user interactions.

title: RentingForce Software System
subtitle: Comprehensive Web-Based Rental Software
description: Enterprise rental management platform for various businesses.
descriptionLong: RentingForce is an enterprise rental management platform designed to support various rental businesses, including car and yacht rentals. It provides features such as booking management, CRM, document generation, multi-language support, and advanced pricing. The platform is built with a scalable architecture using containerization and a combination of relational and document-based storage solutions. It also includes modules for damage management, multi-location support, and reporting. As a student, I contributed by fixing bugs and enhancing UI/UX elements, which improved my skills in enterprise applications, internationalization, and modular system design.

title: Verendus UI Library
subtitle: Reusable React Components for Modern Web Applications
description: A modern UI library built with React and TypeScript, designed for Verendus' web applications.
descriptionLong: We developed a scalable and accessible UI library for Verendus using React and TypeScript. The library is documented with Storybook, ensuring an interactive and well-structured component showcase. It features modular and reusable components tailored for modern web applications, enhancing both maintainability and development efficiency.

title: UI/UX Designs
subtitle: Showcasing Various UI/UX Designs Created in Figma
description: A collection of different UI/UX designs I created using Figma.
descriptionLong: This project showcases a variety of UI/UX designs I have created using Figma. It includes designs for mobile apps, websites, and other digital interfaces, demonstrating my skills in creating user-friendly and visually appealing designs.

title: Jkpg City Rebrand
subtitle: Interactive Website Rebranding for Jkpg City
description: A rebranding project for Jkpg city, focusing on enhancing the user interactivity.
descriptionLong: This project involved rebranding the Jkpg city website to improve user interaction and accessibility. Using modern web technologies such as React and Docker, we transformed the website into a more interactive and dynamic experience.

descriptionLong: This second version of my portfolio leverages React and Next.js to create a dynamic and interactive experience. It features a clean design, showcasing my latest projects and skills, and includes sections for project details, skills, and contact information.

descriptionLong: This first iteration of my personal portfolio was built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It served as a simple static website to present my skills and projects, featuring a straightforward design and easy navigation.

descriptionLong: This website was created to showcase my resume in an accessible and interactive way. The design is minimal yet functional, with all the essential information presented cleanly.
